Target Spheal in Shoal Cave and Chinchou on Route 124 to build a durable team against Juan and the endgame. [1][2]

### Top picks

#### Spheal (core)
* **Where:** Shoal Cave, Walking, Lv26-32 (50% odds in most areas) [1][3]
* **When:** Available once you can Surf to Shoal Cave, north of Mossdeep City. [1][3]
* **Why it helps now:** Spheal evolves into Walrein, a bulky Ice/Water type with Thick Fat that can effectively tank Juan's Kingdra and Sealeo. [4][5]
* **Long run:** Walrein is incredibly valuable for the Elite Four, particularly against Drake's Dragon-types, and holds its own against Wallace. [4][5]
* **Backup:** None.

#### Chinchou (core)
* **Where:** Route 124 (Underwater), Seaweed, Lv20-30 (30% odds) [2]
* **When:** Available as soon as you obtain Dive from Steven in Mossdeep. [2]
* **Why it helps now:** Chinchou evolves into Lanturn, whose Volt Absorb ability and typing give it a huge advantage against Juan's Water-types (except Whiscash). [6]
* **Long run:** Lanturn is a fantastic pivot for the Champion fight against Wallace and can safely switch into many Water and Electric attacks. [6]
* **Backup:** 
  * **Oddish (situational):** Route 123, Walking, Lv26-28 (15% odds) [7][8][9]. Provides Grass-type coverage to quickly eliminate Juan's Whiscash, which is immune to Electric [10]. *Note: Vileplume needs a leaf-stone; make sure you can get one before Sootopolis Gym: Juan.* Evolve_to: Vileplume. Key moves: Petal Dance, Sleep Powder, Giga Drain [7]. Long run: Evolves into Vileplume or Bellossom, offering useful defensive utility and Grass STAB, though it relies heavily on Petal Dance or Giga Drain [7].

---

### Key Battles

#### Gym 8: Juan
Juan leads with Luvdisc (Lv41) and Whiscash (Lv41) [11][12]. Whiscash is immune to Electric and knows Earthquake, threatening Manectric [10]. Breloom handles Whiscash well but must beware of Sealeo's (Lv43) Aurora Beam and Kingdra's (Lv46) Ice Beam [13][14]. Kingdra runs a stall set with Double Team, Rest, and a Chesto Berry [14].

---

### Rules I followed
* **Nuzlocke: first encounter per named location only, dupes clause; gifts, statics and trades are free** (not checked automatically)
* **Encounters already used:** Route 101, Route 102, Route 103, Route 104, Petalburg Woods, Route 116, Rusturf Tunnel, Granite Cave, Route 110, Route 117, Route 111, Route 112, Fiery Path, Route 113, Route 114, Meteor Falls, Route 115, Route 118, Route 119, Route 120, Route 121, Safari Zone, Mt. Pyre (not checked automatically)
* **Level caps: stay at or below the next boss's highest level** (not checked automatically)

### Assumptions
* You have not caught anything on Route 123, Route 124, Shoal Cave, or Sootopolis City.
* Your Breloom has a Grass-type move to handle Whiscash.

### To sharpen this
* What moves are currently on your Breloom and Manectric?
* Do you have the TM for Thunderbolt to teach to Lanturn?

### Not covered
* Exact Nuzlocke dupes clause impacts on Route 123 encounter rates, as other common Pokémon on the route may alter the effective odds of encountering Oddish/Gloom.

plan.headline: Target Spheal in Shoal Cave and Chinchou on Route 124 to build a durable team against Juan and the endgame.

recommendations.where: Shoal Cave, Walking, Lv26-32 (50% odds in most areas)
recommendations.when: Available once you can Surf to Shoal Cave, north of Mossdeep City.
recommendations.why: Spheal evolves into Walrein, a bulky Ice/Water type with Thick Fat that can effectively tank Juan's Kingdra and Sealeo.
recommendations.long_term: Walrein is incredibly valuable for the Elite Four, particularly against Drake's Dragon-types, and holds its own against Wallace.

recommendations.when: Available as soon as you obtain Dive from Steven in Mossdeep.
recommendations.why: Chinchou evolves into Lanturn, whose Volt Absorb ability and typing give it a huge advantage against Juan's Water-types (except Whiscash).
recommendations.long_term: Lanturn is a fantastic pivot for the Champion fight against Wallace and can safely switch into many Water and Electric attacks.

alternatives.why: Provides Grass-type coverage to quickly eliminate Juan's Whiscash, which is immune to Electric.
alternatives.long_term: Evolves into Vileplume or Bellossom, offering useful defensive utility and Grass STAB, though it relies heavily on Petal Dance or Giga Drain.

steps.title: Clear Mossdeep Space Center
steps.detail: Team up with Steven to defeat Team Magma at the Mossdeep Space Center.

steps.title: Explore the remaining seas
steps.detail: Obtain Dive and catch Chinchou on Route 124 and Spheal in Shoal Cave.

steps.title: Challenge Juan
steps.detail: Navigate the Sootopolis Gym and defeat Juan using your new catches alongside Breloom and Manectric.

battle_notes.note: Juan leads with Luvdisc (Lv41) and Whiscash (Lv41). Whiscash is immune to Electric and knows Earthquake, threatening Manectric. Breloom handles Whiscash well but must beware of Sealeo's (Lv43) Aurora Beam and Kingdra's (Lv46) Ice Beam. Kingdra runs a stall set with Double Team, Rest, and a Chesto Berry.

assumptions: You have not caught anything on Route 123, Route 124, Shoal Cave, or Sootopolis City.
Your Breloom has a Grass-type move to handle Whiscash.
